lines.zh: 弯折的膝盖一格一格地转。
lines.en: My bent knees turn one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 每一步都震落屋檐上的灰。
lines.en: Each step shakes dust off the eaves.

lines.zh: 铁皮摩擦，声音比脚步还大。
lines.en: My plates grind louder than my steps.

lines.zh: 我沿着村道走，把坑都踩平。
lines.en: I walk the village road, flattening the ruts.

lines.zh: 关节里塞着藤蔓，我也照走。
lines.en: Vines clog my joints; I walk anyway.

lines.zh: 走三十步，我停一下，看看身后。
lines.en: Thirty steps, then I stop and look behind.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，指节离地很近。
lines.en: Arms hanging, my knuckles near the ground.

lines.zh: 我把路上的石墩挪到一边。
lines.en: I move the stone post out of the path.

lines.zh: 草被我踩倒了又立起来。
lines.en: The grass I crush springs back up.

lines.zh: 夜里走路，铁会发凉。
lines.en: At night my iron turns cold as I walk.

lines.zh: 我在门口站着，站到天亮也行。
lines.en: I can stand at this gate until dawn.

lines.zh: 每秒补一点，伤口自己长回去。
lines.en: One point a second; the wound closes itself.

lines.zh: 村民从窗后看我，我不动。
lines.en: Villagers watch from windows; I stay still.

lines.zh: 腰上的藤蔓又长了一寸。
lines.en: The vine on my waist grew an inch.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条手臂，听关节响。
lines.en: I lift one arm and hear the joint creak.

lines.zh: 我数着村子里的门有几扇。
lines.en: I count how many doors the village has.

lines.zh: 花放在我手心，我没敢握。
lines.en: A flower rests in my palm; I dare not close it.

lines.zh: 我这副铁身，能撑很久。
lines.en: This iron body of mine lasts a long while.

lines.zh: 有人在墙上刻我的样子。
lines.en: Someone carved my shape into the wall.

lines.zh: 我记得每个孩子的名字。
lines.en: I remember the name of every child.

lines.zh: 手指太粗，捏不住细线。
lines.en: My fingers are too thick for thin thread.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮着，其实我不困。
lines.en: My eyes glow, though I never sleep.

lines.zh: 铁锈味混着麦秸味，我闻惯了。
lines.en: Rust and wheat straw — I know that smell.

lines.zh: 要是没人叫我，我就一直站。
lines.en: If no one calls, I simply keep standing.

lines.zh: 雪落在我肩上，我也不抖。
lines.en: Snow settles on my shoulders; I do not shake it off.

lines.zh: 村里的钟还没响，我等着。
lines.en: The village bell has not rung yet; I am waiting.

lines.zh: 你比我矮很多，我低头看你。
lines.en: You're much shorter; I look down at you.

lines.zh: 你是村民吗？不像。
lines.en: Are you a villager? You don't look it.

lines.zh: 我在判断你算不算威胁。
lines.en: I'm deciding whether you count as a threat.

lines.zh: 你的手里没有铁，我放心一点。
lines.en: No iron in your hands; that eases me.

lines.zh: 别站在我要守的那扇门前。
lines.en: Don't stand in front of the door I guard.

lines.zh: 你这样仰着头看我，我习惯了。
lines.en: I'm used to you craning up at me like that.

lines.zh: 我点一下头，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I nod once, which counts as greeting.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声很轻，不像敌人。
lines.en: Your steps are quiet, unlike an enemy's.

lines.zh: 我看得久了，你也别怕。
lines.en: I stare a while; don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 要我搬东西的话，先说清楚。
lines.en: If you need something carried, say so plainly.

lines.zh: 眼睛里的红点转向了你。
lines.en: The red pinpoints in my eyes turn to you.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，我转身慢。
lines.en: Stand further off; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 铁被打出一个小坑，不深。
lines.en: A small dent, no deeper than that.

lines.zh: 每秒补一点，你打不穿。
lines.en: One point a second; you can't wear through.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的藤打断了。
lines.en: That broke the vine on my arm.

lines.zh: 这一下让我膝盖弯了半寸。
lines.en: That bent my knee half an inch.

lines.zh: 痛觉迟钝，但我知道疼。
lines.en: My senses are dull, but I know pain.

lines.zh: 你砍在关节上，很聪明。
lines.en: Hitting the joint was clever of you.

lines.zh: 铁片掉了一块，不碍事。
lines.en: A plate chipped off; it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我修得好。
lines.en: I can mend this much damage.

lines.zh: 别打断我的手，我还要守门。
lines.en: Don't break my arm; I still guard a door.

lines.zh: 铁脚往后挪了半格，就到这。
lines.en: My iron foot slid back half a block, that's all.

lines.zh: 铁不吃东西，你收起来吧。
lines.en: Iron doesn't eat; put that away.

lines.zh: 罂粟花我留着，但不为它走。
lines.en: I'll keep the poppy, but I won't walk for it.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我只看你的手。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I watch your hand.

lines.zh: 我不用喂，我只要有人守。
lines.en: I need no feeding, only someone to guard.

lines.zh: 花环挂在我脖子上，会掉。
lines.en: A wreath on my neck would slip off.

lines.zh: 别用食物引我，我不是狼。
lines.en: Don't lure me with food; I'm not a wolf.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我替你看管。
lines.en: Leave it there; I'll keep an eye on it.

lines.zh: 我闻不出香味，只闻出铁。
lines.en: I smell no sweetness, only iron.

lines.zh: 那朵花你拿着，比我拿着好。
lines.en: Better that flower stays in your hand.

lines.zh: 勾引我做的事，我一件都不做。
lines.en: Nothing you dangle will make me act.

lines.zh: 我一步没退，你退了两步。
lines.en: I didn't step back; you took two.

lines.zh: 撞上铁，你的肩膀会痛。
lines.en: Shoulders against iron tend to hurt.

lines.zh: 我抬手把你扶稳了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and steady you.

lines.zh: 别挤，我转身要占三格。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; my turn needs three blocks.

lines.zh: 你碰到我腰上的藤了。
lines.en: You brushed the vine at my waist.

lines.zh: 铁皮很凉，撞一下能记住。
lines.en: My plates are cold; one bump will remind you.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了半步，你先走。
lines.en: I shift half a step aside; go ahead.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的关节撞响了。
lines.en: That knock rattled my joints loose.

lines.zh: 我站得很稳，你推不动。
lines.en: I stand firm; you can't move me.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背了，没事。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; it's fine.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡不结伴，我是被造出来的。
lines.en: Iron golems don't pair; I was built.

lines.zh: 两只铁傀儡站一起，只会更吵。
lines.en: Two golems together only grind louder.

lines.zh: 我没有那样的心思。
lines.en: I have no such thoughts in me.

lines.zh: 我的伴是这条村道。
lines.en: My companion is this village road.

lines.zh: 造我的人没教过我这件。
lines.en: Whoever built me never taught me that.

lines.zh: 孩子拉住我的手，那就够了。
lines.en: A child holding my hand is enough.

lines.zh: 别在我面前说这些。
lines.en: Don't speak of such things near me.

lines.zh: 石头不会互相喜欢。
lines.en: Stones don't take a liking to stones.

lines.zh: 我守村子，不守谁的家。
lines.en: I guard the village, not one household.

lines.zh: 这种问题，问铁匠去。
lines.en: Ask a blacksmith about that sort of thing.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，是为了给人留着。
lines.en: I pick it up to keep it for its owner.

lines.zh: 手指太粗，捡小东西要慢。
lines.en: Thick fingers; small things take time.

lines.zh: 我把南瓜轻轻放在台阶上。
lines.en: I set the pumpkin gently on the step.

lines.zh: 掉了东西的，来我这儿领。
lines.en: If you dropped something, claim it here.

lines.zh: 这袋麦子我替他们扛回去。
lines.en: I'll carry this wheat back for them.

lines.zh: 拿起来之前，我先看清是谁的。
lines.en: Before lifting it, I learn whose it is.

lines.zh: 我把门闩放回原处。
lines.en: I put the door bar back in place.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，两只手一起托。
lines.en: Heavy loads I cradle with both hands.

lines.zh: 这块铁片，我留着补自己。
lines.en: This iron scrap I keep to patch myself.

lines.zh: 别抢，我看得见你们的手。
lines.en: Don't grab; I see all your hands.

lines.zh: 你先动手的，我记住了。
lines.en: You struck first; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 站在我面前的，都算目标。
lines.en: Anyone before me counts as a target.

lines.zh: 我迈出一步，地就沉下去一点。
lines.en: I step once, and the ground sinks a little.

lines.zh: 村民在屋里，我不许你靠近。
lines.en: The villagers are indoors; you won't reach them.

lines.zh: 拳已经举到肩上了。
lines.en: My fist is already up at my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你手上那把剑，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the sword in your hand.

lines.zh: 锁定了，就不会再改。
lines.en: Target set; it won't change again.

lines.zh: 我优先守人，其次才打你。
lines.en: I shield the people first, then hit you.

lines.zh: 你退到田里，我也跟进去。
lines.en: Retreat to the fields and I follow.

lines.zh: 铁皮里面的火亮了一下。
lines.en: A light flares inside my iron shell.

lines.zh: 我不能再装作没看见了。
lines.en: I can no longer pretend not to see.

lines.zh: 五十格之内，都在我脚下。
lines.en: Fifty blocks of ground lie under my feet.

lines.zh: 这一拳，为的是那扇被砸的门。
lines.en: This fist is for that smashed door.

lines.zh: 动吧，我等着你的第一步。
lines.en: Move, then; I wait for your first step.

lines.zh: 你把锄头举起来了，不对。
lines.en: You raised a hoe at me. That is wrong.

lines.zh: 第一下我让你，第二下不让。
lines.en: I will let the first hit pass, not the second.

lines.zh: 有人叫了一声，我就知道方向。
lines.en: Someone cried out; now I know the direction.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过整条田垄。
lines.en: One step carries me over the whole field row.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，让拳头对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, bringing my fist to bear.

lines.zh: 我先封住你往村里的路。
lines.en: First I cut off your road to the village.

lines.zh: 你绕我身后，我也听得见。
lines.en: Circle behind me; I still hear you.

lines.zh: 手臂抬到一半，是在算距离。
lines.en: Arm half raised, I'm measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 你退一格，我进一步。
lines.en: You step back one; I advance one.

lines.zh: 我把两只手张开，挡住门。
lines.en: I spread both arms across the doorway.

lines.zh: 脚下这一圈，我已经踩实了。
lines.en: This ring of ground is already tamped firm.

lines.zh: 你在等我慢下来，对不对。
lines.en: You're waiting for me to slow down, aren't you.

lines.zh: 横扫比直拳更快。
lines.en: A sweep lands quicker than a straight punch.

lines.zh: 我听见骨头在铁里响。
lines.en: I hear bone grinding inside the iron.

lines.zh: 别站我正前方，那里最险。
lines.en: Don't stand dead ahead; that's the worst spot.

lines.zh: 我把你挤到墙角，就好办了。
lines.en: Once I crowd you to the corner, it's simple.

lines.zh: 我的影子挡住了太阳。
lines.en: My shadow has swallowed the sun.

lines.zh: 这一脚抬起来，你要么跑要么挡。
lines.en: This foot is up; run or block.

lines.zh: 我的铁膝盖已经弯折到位。
lines.en: My iron knees are already bent and braced.

lines.zh: 我每一步，都在你脚下震动。
lines.en: Every step I take shakes the ground beneath you.

lines.zh: 我数到三，你的腿就该软了。
lines.en: By my count of three, your legs will fail.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西挡不住铁。
lines.en: What you hold cannot stop iron.

lines.zh: 我停一下，是让你先跑。
lines.en: I pause a moment to let you run first.

lines.zh: 这一拳的落点已经定好。
lines.en: This punch already has its landing spot.

lines.zh: 一拳下去，地面裂了一圈。
lines.en: One punch, and the ground cracks in a ring.

lines.zh: 两只手臂横扫，把你推出去。
lines.en: Both arms sweep you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我踏了一下地，碎石飞起来。
lines.en: I stamp once, and gravel sprays up.

lines.zh: 拳头撞在盾上，盾凹了。
lines.en: My fist meets the shield and dents it.

lines.zh: 你被抛起来，又落回原地。
lines.en: You're thrown up, then land where you stood.

lines.zh: 这一击不重，我只是警告。
lines.en: That one was light; only a warning.

lines.zh: 我抬手拍开你射来的箭。
lines.en: I swat your arrow aside with a hand.

lines.zh: 五十格的土都在抖。
lines.en: The dirt shakes fifty blocks out.

lines.zh: 我把你按在墙上，没有收力。
lines.en: I press you to the wall without easing off.

lines.zh: 这一拳为了那扇倒下的门。
lines.en: This punch is for the door that fell.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我手里像纸。
lines.en: Your armor folds like paper in my grip.

lines.zh: 我打完这一下，会停半秒。
lines.en: After this blow I pause half a second.

lines.zh: 铁和铁相撞，声音传得很远。
lines.en: Iron on iron; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 你还在动，那我就再来一次。
lines.en: You're still moving, so here's another.

lines.zh: 南瓜头落下，铁块自己拼起来。
lines.en: A pumpkin drops; iron blocks assemble themselves.

lines.zh: 我从地里站起来，先看村里。
lines.en: I rise from the ground and look to the village.

lines.zh: 踩塌的地方，我一会儿补。
lines.en: I'll patch the ground I caved in later.

lines.zh: 谁把我拼错了？关节是弯的。
lines.en: Who assembled me wrong? My joints bend.

lines.zh: 藤蔓还缠在我腰上。
lines.en: Vines still wrap around my waist.

lines.zh: 这一带的墙矮了，我记住。
lines.en: These walls are low here; I'll remember.

lines.zh: 我还没动，地已经响了。
lines.en: I haven't moved, and the ground already groans.

lines.zh: 你们站开，我起来要三格。
lines.en: Stand clear; standing up takes three blocks.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找门。
lines.en: The first thing I do is find a door.

lines.zh: 铁身会生锈，但先得站起来。
lines.en: This iron will rust, but first I must stand.

lines.zh: 有人砸了村子，我就来了。
lines.en: Someone broke the village, so here I am.

lines.zh: 脚下一圈草被压平了。
lines.en: A ring of grass is pressed flat around me.

lines.zh: 我不是来谈条件的。
lines.en: I didn't come here to bargain.

lines.zh: 抬头看，我比门框高。
lines.en: Look up; I'm taller than the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我站起来，先掸掉身上的土。
lines.en: I rise and brush the dirt off first.

lines.zh: 铁块一块压一块，压成了我。
lines.en: One iron block pressed on another, and that made me.

lines.zh: 这地方的空地够我站直吗。
lines.en: Is there room here for me to stand upright?

lines.zh: 关节第一次弯，铁的声音很生。
lines.en: My joints bend for the first time, the iron sound raw.

lines.zh: 谁在我背后留了一个缺口。
lines.en: Someone left a gap in my back.

lines.zh: 我先看看最近的村子在哪。
lines.en: First I look for the nearest village.

lines.zh: 火烤得铁发烫，我先躲开。
lines.en: Fire heats my iron; I step away first.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我砸出个坑。
lines.en: Falling from height, I leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水灌进铁缝里，我变重了。
lines.en: Water fills my seams and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 炸开的碎片打在背上，闷响。
lines.en: Shrapnel hits my back with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 箭插进铁缝，拔出来就好。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in a seam; I'll pull it out.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西缠住我，我的动作慢了。
lines.en: Violet threads slow my arms and legs.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是锈会快些。
lines.en: I don't eat; I only rust a little faster.

lines.zh: 雷击中头顶，整个身子都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my head and my whole body glows.

lines.zh: 底下没东西，我抓不到边。
lines.en: Nothing below and no edge to grab.
